header.running_head: The Strength of the Imaan of the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: remain in one of three conditions. (Firstly) The condition when I am reciting Qur'aan or listening to it being recited, (secondly) the condition when I am listening to Rasulullaah ﷺ's sermon and (thirdly) the condition when I am present at a funeral. At every funeral I have been, I have thought about nothing other than what will become of the deceased or where it is heading.'"[^1]
Haakim, reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Dhahabi.
